dv_in_001.speaker: dusty_vane
dv_in_001.text: You've got the look of someone about to walk somewhere stupid. I'm Dusty. I shoot things for a living, and lately the living's been thin. Make it worth my while and I'll walk into the stupid with you.

choices.text: Watch my back, then. You're hired.
Why should I trust a stranger with a gun?

dv_in_who.speaker: dusty_vane
dv_in_who.text: You shouldn't. But I've never shot a paying employer, and I don't intend to start — bad for business. Decide.

dv_in_join.speaker: dusty_vane
dv_in_join.text: Smart. Stay in front of me and try not to bleed on my boots. Let's move.

dv_p_001.speaker: dusty_vane
dv_p_001.text: Still breathing. Good. What's the word — keep moving, or am I off the hook?

choices.text: Keep moving. I still need you.
We're done. Sit this next one out.

dv_p_part.speaker: dusty_vane
dv_p_part.text: Suits me. I'll be here, nursing a drink, when you remember you need a gun. Find me when you do.

dv_r_001.speaker: dusty_vane
dv_r_001.text: Knew you'd be back. Same deal — I shoot, you pay in not-getting-me-killed. In or out?

dv_r_join.speaker: dusty_vane
dv_r_join.text: That's the spirit. Let's go ruin someone's day.
